[[File:국가수리과학연구소 National Institute for Mathematical Sciences (NIMS) entrance.jpg|thumb|Indoor entrance to NIMS]]
The '''National Institute for Mathematical Sciences''' ('''NIMS'''; {{Korean|hangul=국가수리과학연구소}}) is a Korean government-funded mathematics research institute. Their work focuses both basic research and [[applied mathematics]] with  industrial and medical applications.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.nims.re.kr/eng/about/pageView/178 |title= Research Fields |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website= National Institute for Mathematical Sciences |publisher= |access-date= 5 April 2022 |quote= }}</ref> 

==History==
Founded in 2005,<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.fnnews.com/news/202203140837419139 |title= 김현민 수리연 소장 "수학, AI의 핵심…투자 턱없이 부족해" |author= 이진영 |date= 14 March 2022 |website= |publisher=[[Newsis]] |access-date= 26 May 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> NIMS became an affiliated research institute of the [[Institute for Basic Science]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.nims.re.kr/eng/about/pageView/174 |title= History |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website= National Institute for Mathematical Sciences |publisher= |access-date= 5 April 2022 |quote= }}</ref> After delays for multiple years,<ref>{{cite web |url= https://m.khan.co.kr/opinion/contribution/article/202008210300015 |title= [기고] 수학이 국가의 미래다 |author= 엄치용 |date= 21 August 2020 |website= |publisher=[[Kyunghyang Shinmun]] |access-date= 5 April 2022 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> relocation is planned for late 2023.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://m.daejonilbo.com/mnews.asp?pk_no=1465541 |title= 국가수리과학연구소 신청사 이전 속도낼까 |author=정인선 |date= 4 April 2021 |website= |publisher= 대전일보 |access-date= 5 April 2022 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> The vision of NIMS is to "attain a global top 10 competitiveness in industrial mathematics research by 2028".<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.nims.re.kr/eng/about/pageView/627 |title= Mission/Vision |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= National Institute for Mathematical Sciences |publisher= |access-date= 26 May 2023 |quote= }}</ref> NIMS celebrated its 20th anniversary in 2025.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10587079 |title= 최윤성 수리硏 소장 “독립청사 건립, 제2의 도약 추진” |author= 구본혁 |date= 30 September 2025 |website= [[The Korea Herald]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 February 2026 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
